# Portable document

This document ships to non-GitHub renderers (npm, forums, static sites). It must remain CommonMark-only.

## Bare URL

Visit https://example.com/portable for details. The bare URL must stay wrapped or flagged, never auto-linked.

## Status

- [ ] Task lists are NOT portable — this bracket syntax must be converted to a plain bullet or flagged.
- [x] Completed tasks use the same non-portable syntax.

## Emoji

Use :rocket: sparingly — shortcodes do not render outside GitHub.
